content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-46. - Peremptory challenges.
content.summary:
In all cases arising under this Code or other ordinances of the city wherein a jury
               trial is had, each party shall be entitled to three peremptory challenges.
(Code 1960, § 1-13; Code 1981, § 18-34)
